summary: TTS bug fixes fully validated. Backend: 7/7 pytest OK (health, conversations, /api/tts/voices provider=edge-tts, voice normalization Denise:Dragon->DeniseNeural, DeniseNeural/CelesteNeural return >5KB audio with correct X-TTS-Voice, bogus voice falls back to non-empty audio). Frontend Playwright: BUG 1 stop works (aria-label toggles back to 'Lire à voix haute', no extra /api/tts request after stop), BUG 2 confirmed (POST /api/tts fires and window.speechSynthesis.speak stub reports __spoke=false), single-stream verified (clicking another message's TTS button flips aria: first msg 'Lire', second 'Arrêter'), VoicePicker lists 14 fr voices with fr-FR-DeniseNeural + fr-FR-CelesteNeural pinned first and NO 'fr-FR-Denise:DragonLatestNeural' present, provider label 'edge-tts' shown, voice-test-btn fires POST /api/tts, changing voice via voice-select works.
critical_code_review_comments: tts.js uses new Audio() (detached from DOM) so document.querySelector('audio') can't observe playback state from tests. This is fine functionally but note that any future e2e assertion of paused/src must use module state, not DOM. Current tests use aria-label + network log which is reliable.

In tts.js if speak() throws before audio is attached (e.g. axios error), stopSpeech() is not called and onStopCb is never invoked; ChatMessage handles this by setting speaking=false in its own catch block, so state stays consistent. OK.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing conversation 44be4246-ebb7-48c6-b0b8-dfd5db24730e with two assistant messages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TTS provider is edge-tts (keyless). Fixture must extract 'token' from /api/auth/login (not 'access_token'). Audio element in tts.js is created via new Audio() so it is NOT in DOM — use aria-label of tts-msg-{id} and network requests to /api/tts as the source of truth for state.
rca of the issue: All 3 reported TTS bugs are fixed: (1) stopSpeech aborts fetch + pauses audio + clears src -> button flips back and no extra request fires; (2) ChatMessage.toggleSpeak calls speak() which POSTs /api/tts, no SpeechSynthesis path remains; (3) backend _normalize_voice strips ':' suffix and edge-tts serves proper MP3 for both DeniseNeural and CelesteNeural, bogus voice falls back to default rather than returning 0-byte stream.
